r12_trunk_clearance.residual: For each original trunk collision geom: smooth_positive(max(floor_margin,geom_margin)-signed_geom_distance)/0.001; quadratic norm, 1 micrometre hinge smoothing.
r12_trunk_clearance.geometry: Original floor and seven trunk collision geoms (7..13 in retained ep10), selected from trunk body and original collision masks. Actual runner permits all leg-body contacts and terminates on trunk-floor contact.
r12_trunk_clearance.activation: Every predicted state, including the original terminal knot. No true material q/e, new sensor, geometry, margin or plant terminal change.
r12_trunk_clearance.scale_basis: The original trunk margin is 1 mm. Retain MaterialDomainMargin's 176-node weight so a one-scale forbidden-contact deficit at a single prediction knot contributes 0.5 to the horizon-mean cost. This is a soft optimization penalty, not a hard feasibility guarantee.

evidence.analysis: Kinematic evaluation of saved prediction states only; no physical rerun or optimization. Listed existing components are Upright, MaterialSupportHeight and MaterialDomainMargin, not a complete cost replay.

r12_trunk_clearance.qualification: Engineering correction followed directly by the authorized W34 PANN training; no E30/E60 qualification or controller benefit claimed.
